instagram.caption:
If you pirated EarthBound, the game deleted your save at the final boss.

First it filled the map with far more enemies than normal, to make a copied game miserable to play.

If you pushed through for hours anyway, it froze during the last fight. When you reset the console, every save file was gone.

Would you have started again?
